description_en: Stops the execution of a lifecycle policy
description_zh: 停止执行生命周期策略
kebab_example: aliyun nas stop-lifecycle-policy-execution --file-system-id bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64ya0000 --lifecycle-policy-id lc-xxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: StopLifecyclePolicyExecution

parameters.help_en:
The file system ID. The ID starts with bmcpfs-, such as bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64ya****.
This operation is supported only when LifecyclePolicyType is set to OnDemand in the lifecycle management policy of a CPFS for Lingjun file system
parameters.help_zh:
文件系统ID。以bmcpfs-开头，如bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64ya****。
仅 CPFS 智算版文件系统的生命周期管理策略中 LifecyclePolicyType 为 OnDemand 时支持
parameters.name: file_system_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the lifecycle policy
parameters.name: lifecycle_policy_id
